description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed. On the verge of death, you drain the life of all around you in a desperate attempt to remain alive. You avoid being knocked out and remain at 1 Hit Point. Each creature in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:60] must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:spell|options:area-effect,damaging-effect] saving throw against your spell DC. You regain Hit Points equal to the total damage dealt, up to a maximum of half your maximum Hit Points.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes void damage equal to half its level.

Failure The target takes void damage equal to its level.

Critical Failure The target takes void damage equal to double its level.
